title: New defaults with every setting checked as applied; rain padding; the Skin jump fixed; sound design; star layers, beams and grid styles; each corner of the futuristic frames with tiles; presets and saved looks; fast on phones and every screen
body:
Fixes #15

Each item of the issue is listed below with its solution and the test that checks it. The full analysis is in the case study [`docs/case-studies/issue-15/README.md`](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-15-c7170c04f74e/docs/case-studies/issue-15/README.md). It covers every requirement with where it is done and what verifies it, the root causes, the measurements, a comparison with konard/immortality, libraries and online research, and the remaining limits.

## The new defaults, and every setting actually applied

- **Defaults.** The 21 values of the JSON in the issue are the new defaults. `src/settings/settings.test.js` holds that JSON exactly as given and checks that the defaults match it.
- **"Double check that all settings are actually applied."** `src/settings/applied.test.js` goes through all 251 settings and fails for any setting that is not used. A setting counts as used when:
  - a stylesheet uses its CSS variable or attribute;
  - a background layer reads it (recorded through a `Proxy`);
  - a component reads its key.

  A second test checks that every choice of every select has a CSS rule or a script that reads it.

## Space around every rain symbol

- **The setting.** `rain.padding`: free space on every side of a symbol, 0–16 px.
- **Found on the way.** The rain glow was half as large on Retina screens: `shadowBlur` counts canvas pixels, not CSS pixels. It is now scaled by `devicePixelRatio`.
- **Tests.** `src/components/visuals.test.jsx`.

## The Skin block jumped and was misaligned

- **Root cause.** The settings page laid out its sections with CSS multi-column. The browser balances columns by height, and the skin sections differ in height. Choosing liquid instead of glass therefore moved Rain to the other column, and every section after it, Skin included, moved too. In WebKit every section fell into one column with negative tops (−365 and −579 px).
- **How to reproduce.** Run `npm run build && npx vite preview --port 4173`, then `ENGINE=chromium|firefox|webkit node experiments/settings-layout.mjs`. It prints the column of each section for each skin.
  - Before the fix: "sections that change their column between glass and liquid: rain".
  - After the fix: "none", with equal column tops in all three browsers.
  - The logs are in `docs/case-studies/issue-15/data/layout-*.log`.
- **Fix.** Two fixed columns. Every row is one label | control | value | reset grid. In a section with tabs, the settings shared by all tabs come before the tabs.
- **Tests.** `src/pages/settings.test.jsx`.

## Polish: the glass skin

- **Blue panels.** The saturation was stored as a plain number, so `saturate(100)` meant ×100 and painted the panels blue. Values above 2 are now divided by 100.
- **Panels without blur.** Page cards, Habr cards, the language cloud and the theory panels had no blur. One rule now gives every panel the blur and radius.
- **New settings, for the questionable choices.** The colour behind panels, borders and lines, the shadow, and the light on the upper edge.
- **Tests.** `src/skins.test.jsx`.

## Background: levels and detailed settings for every layer

- **Universe.** Strength, speed, gas, hue, four colours, zoom, its own stars (amount, size, colour, brightness, twinkling), vignette, frames per second and resolution.
- **Up to four star layers on top of each other.** Each layer has:
  - 12 shapes: dot, soft, ring, square, diamond, cross, ×, 4-, 5- and 6-pointed stars, sparkle, flare;
  - size and size variety;
  - colour and colour variety, brightness;
  - glow and glow colour;
  - twinkling speed and depth, rotation and spin;
  - motion: still, drift, warp towards you or orbit, with a direction and speed;
  - streaks and blending.
- **Beams: the "effects that go vertically and horizontally".** Light runs along the grid lines, horizontally, vertically or both. Settings: number, speed, length, width, style, colour, glow and pause.
- **Grid.** Styles: lines, dashes, crosses and dots. Also marks, line width, colour, tint and fading.
- **Cost.** The star and beam code is loaded only when a layer is switched on.
- **Tests.** `src/visuals/layers.test.jsx`.

## Futuristic frames: each corner on its own, with preview tiles

- **Each corner** has its own shape and its own line, and one size applies to all corners.
  - 7 shapes: square, cut, tall cut, wide cut, round, scoop, notch.
  - 5 lines: none (a missing border, as before), gap, line, accent, bracket.
- **Tiles.** Every choice is a tile that previews the real corner in the current colours. A button makes every corner like the chosen one.
- **How it is drawn.** `src/skins.frames.js` generates `src/skins.frames.css` (`npm run build:frames`) from `clip-path` polygons and gradient lines. CSS `corner-shape` is not Baseline yet (Chrome and Edge 139+ only, [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/corner-shape)), so polygons are used.
- **Tests.** `src/skins.frames.test.jsx` checks that the stylesheet is up to date, plus the geometry and the tiles.

## Sound design

- **31 synthesized sounds.** 26 come from konard/immortality (the Unlicense) and 5 are new: raindrop, link, glass, warp, byte. There are no audio files.
- **10 interactions.** Each has up to four sounds with a level for each, played at random, in turn or together.
- **The mix.** Volume, tone, room echo and room size, pitch variation, stereo towards the pointer and its width, and the shortest gap between two sounds.
- **Controls.** A ▶ for every sound and a sound switch in the top bar. Sound is off by default, and its code is loaded only when it is switched on.
- **Root cause of a click in mica.** A `GainNode` starts at 1 until its first event, so one sample of full-scale noise got through, and mica sounded 15 times too loud.
  - Found with `experiments/sound-render.mjs` and `experiments/sound-isolate.mjs`.
  - Fixed with `amp.gain.value = 0`.
- **Tests.** `src/sound/sound.test.jsx` and `src/components/Sound.test.jsx`. `experiments/sound-e2e.mjs` checks it in a real browser.

## Presets, saved looks and links

- **9 built-in presets**, each with a miniature drawn from its settings: Default, Calm, Matrix, Deep space, Warp, Neon HUD, Liquid, Blueprint, and Light and fast.
- **Saved looks.** Save, apply, update, rename and delete. Copy as JSON and load in another browser. They stay in sync between tabs.
- **A random look.** It is never heavier than the defaults: no more things drawn, frames per second or resolution.
- **A `#settings=` link.** It carries a look and keeps the look it replaced as "Before the link".
- **What a look never changes.** The motion, volume or notation.
- **Cost.** The preset code is loaded only on the settings page or with such a link.
- **Tests.** `src/settings/presets.test.js` and `src/pages/presets.test.jsx`. `experiments/presets-e2e.mjs` checks it in a real browser.

## Fast on mobile

`experiments/perf-mobile.mjs` measures a phone: 412×915, a CPU slowed four times, slow 4G, medians of 3 runs. The results are in `data/perf-mobile-{main,branch}.json`.

| Page | FCP, ms | Long tasks, ms | Background frames/s | kB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | 2844 → 3056 | 5405 → 3359 | 6 → 13 | 204 → 217 |
| `/settings/` | 1788 → 2052 | 5293 → 2817 | 6 → 16 | 126 → 128 |
| `/art/` | 2204 → 2416 | 5581 → 3005 | 6 → 19 | 168 → 161 |
| `/blog/` | 2108 → 2064 | 5527 → 3830 | 7 → 15 | 142 → 135 |
| `/cv/` | 1784 → 1864 | 5477 → 2836 | 6 → 21 | 135 → 150 |

- **A governor** (`src/visuals/governor.js`) watches the frame gaps. While the page cannot keep up, it lowers the resolution and then the frame rate of the universe, and the frame rate of stars and beams. The universe is the costly layer: switching it off alone gives 25 frames/s.
- **Smaller shared code.** The code shared by all pages no longer carries the career data. The Layout chunk went from 111.5 to 91.2 kB gzip.
- **Stated plainly.** Long tasks are about 45% shorter and the background runs 2–3× more frames per second. FCP is not better: it is 80–260 ms later on four pages and 44 ms earlier on `/blog/`. The pages are rendered in the browser, and pre-rendering them is a change to the build of every page (see the limits in the case study).
- **Tests.** `src/visuals/governor.test.js`.

## Every screen

`experiments/responsive.mjs` checks 9 pages × 4 widths (360, 768, 1280, 1920) × 2 themes. For each case it checks:

- nothing scrolls sideways;
- no element sticks out of the screen;
- the current page is visible in the top bar, with at least three page links.

**main fails 8 of the 72 cases** (`data/responsive-main.log`): at 360 px, two page links and a hidden current page; at 768 px, `/blog/` hides the current page. **This branch passes 72 of 72.**

- **The fixes.**
  - On phones the page links get their own row, and the current page is scrolled into view.
  - The section links stay on phones; before, only the ↑ was left.
  - A list fades only at an edge with more links behind it.
  - The blog filter's checkbox is no longer stretched.
- **Tests.** `src/components/edges.test.js`.

## Better than konard/immortality

| | immortality | This site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Settings | about 50 axes | 251, each checked by a test to be applied |
| Presets | 12 built-in | 9 built-in with live miniatures, plus named saved looks (JSON export and import, synced between tabs) |
| Frames | one style per panel | each corner on its own: 7 shapes × 5 lines with preview tiles |
| Background | a set of backgrounds | five layers with strengths, up to 4 star layers with 12 shapes, beams, grid styles |
| Sound | effects per event | its 26 effects plus 5, up to 4 per interaction with levels and play modes, room echo, stereo |
| Phones | not measured | measured, a governor, optional parts loaded lazily |

## Checks

- `npm run test:ci`: 533 tests in 25 files pass.
- `npm run check` passes: ESLint, Prettier, the 1500-line limit and secretlint.
- `npm run build` passes.
- **Dependencies.** `npm audit` in CI failed on four new moderate advisories in `fast-uri`, which secretlint uses through `ajv`. `npm audit fix` updated the lockfile to `fast-uri` 3.1.9.
- **Cleanup.** The `.gitkeep` file from the initial commit is removed.
